module: Third-party library lustache: string scanner used by the template parser. It keeps the remaining "tail" of the string (`tail`) and the current position (`pos`) and advances by consuming text with Lua patterns.
notes: Instance created by `Scanner:new(str)`: fields str, tail (remainder to read) and pos (position, starts at 1).
The source comments talk about "null"; in Lua, `scan` returns nil when the pattern does not match at the start of the tail.

new.desc: Creates a scanner on `str` (tail = str, pos = 1).

eos.desc: True if the tail is empty (end of string).

scan.desc: Tries to match `pattern` exactly at the start of the tail; if so, consumes and returns the text found, otherwise returns nil.

scan_until.desc: Advances to the next match of `pattern` and returns the skipped text. Returns the whole tail if there is no match; returns nil if the pattern matches right at the current position.
